messages:
Ravi: spotted ~6h of missing aggregate-hours for EU region, looks like late-event bump from kafka shard rebalances. Thinking we run a targeted recompute for affected tenant cohort. thoughts on routing?
Lena: estimate? we need to know cost impact before touching priority pools.
Ravi: rough: 80 shards, ~1.2k tasks, ~28k agg-units, likely 90-120m on reserved pool if we allow short parallelism.
Priya: console/UX question: if we expose a 'fast path' toggle should the default be off? ops will hate surprises.
Sam: backend: simpler to accept "priority=true" param on POST /recompute, allocator will map to priority lane. avoids new endpoint churn.
Lena: agree on param. But enforce can only be used by users with allow_priority_recompute flag. otherwise 403.
Ravi: good, we already have per-tenant feature flags in tenant-metadata. we'll gate it.
Priya: UI: make it a non-checked checkbox labeled "Use priority lane (may draw from reserved pool)" with a tooltip linking to cost estimate. also show an estimated ETA range.
Sam: operationally, add a prefetch stage for kv warming and staggered shard batches to avoid cache churn. add ?prefetch=true param.
infra-bot: Job queued: recompute-eu-6379991110, id=rb-2024-09-02-0915, priority=true, prefetch=true
Lena: Billing owners looped: @Billing-Team please review potential chargeable usage. cost-bot: can you post an upfront est?
cost-bot: Est: ~28k agg-units -> ~$42 (estimated). See /internal/costs/rb-2024-09-02-0915 for breakdown.
Priya: Also add SLI monitors: recompute_cpu_p95, dedicated_latency_p95; create temporary alert if regression >7% for 30m.
Sam: For routing, note that reserved-pool autoscaler may preempt opportunistic slots. We'll limit priority to 12 concurrent slots to keep Dedicated unaffected.
Ravi: starting a 5-shard canary now in priority lane. will watch cache-miss, cpu, and billing est.
Lena: I'll watch cost dashboard and ping billing if it spikes.
Priya: I'll add the checkbox and modal copy in a small PR, posting screenshots shortly.
Sam: reminder: ensure API audit logs include priority flag and user who triggered it for compliance.
Ravi: canary successful: 5 shards done, cache miss down after prefetch, CPU within expected delta. proceeding to ramp to 12 slots. will post final metrics when complete. :rocket:
